item.title: Broken lid on dog poo bin, 16th November
item.description:
Is anyone at the council able to look at getting this fixed? The lid of the dog poo bin on the Kayte lane dog field is rusted through and razor sharp. It's just asking to slice the end of someone's finger. Cut + Rust + Dog poo make for a pretty nasty infection. Initially reported it 6 months ago when it was just starting to rust through, now it's almost broken in half. Cllr Cheryl AggIs anyone at the council able to look at getting this fixed?
